_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Make show notes from a transcript...

description: Use this after transcribe_media, or when the user has a transcript, for "write show notes for this episode", "add YouTube chapters to my video", "pull the best quotes". Pass exactly one of transcript_id (with library_id when transcribe_media gave one), transcript (the text, or an SRT or VTT file) or url (the same link). Returns a summary, chapters with times and YouTube chapter lines, up to 3 quotes with times, keywords, Markdown show notes and post_topic for draft_posts. Fixed rules pick sentences as spoken; no model, no cost.

confirm_rights.description: With url only, as for transcribe_media: true only after the user says they own the recording or may use it. A public social video needs none.

library_id.description: The library_id that same transcribe_media answer gave, such as lib_9b6a98861ea4f54bff8f5cf1. Pass it with transcript_id when the answer had one.

title.description: Episode or video title for the notes (default: the transcript's title).

transcript.description: The transcript itself: plain text, or the text of an SRT or WebVTT file (its times become chapter times), up to 60000 characters.

transcript_id.description: The transcript_id a transcribe_media answer gave, such as tr_a6f8c87a9b2eb748. Give exactly one of transcript_id, transcript or url.

url.description: The same link given to transcribe_media: a public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or other social video, or a direct audio or video file link. It is transcribed again under Transcript Kit's daily minutes; transcript_id costs nothing.

name: make_show_notes

at.description: The time as a clock, such as 2:05; null when the transcript had no times.

start.description: Seconds from the start; null when the transcript had no times.

title.description: The words this part uses most.

description_markdown.description: Summary, chapters, quotes and keywords as Markdown to paste under the episode or video. Markdown signs in the spoken text are escaped, but a bare www. or http(s):// address or an email address in it is not, so it becomes a link where GitHub Flavored Markdown is rendered: check links before publishing.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the recording; null when the transcript had no times.

key_quotes.description: Up to 3 sentences of 8 to 35 words, as spoken, for a quote card or a post.

at.description: The time as a clock, such as 2:05; null when the transcript had no times.

start.description: Seconds from the start; null when the transcript had no times.

keywords.description: The words said most often, for tags.

language.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code; null for pasted text.

post_topic.description: The title and summary in one paragraph, as the topic of a post about the episode.

kind.description: What the notes were made from.

library_id.description: Pass with transcript_id to Transcript Kit's tools when set.

transcript_id.description: The saved transcript, for Transcript Kit's other tools; null for pasted text.

status.description: ok: the notes are ready. A refused call returns an error text such as "transcript_not_found: ..." that says what to do next.

summary.description: 3 to 5 sentences from the transcript that carry its most repeated words, in spoken order.

youtube_chapters.description: The chapters as lines to paste into a YouTube description (0:00 first, 3 or more, each 10 s or longer); null when that is not possible.

title: Make show notes from a transcript
